Lemmings 2 - The Tribes.name: Lemmings 2: The Tribes
Lemmings 2 - The Tribes.summary: Completed but unreleased ports of Lemmings 2: The Tribes for Master System and Game Gear.

Psychic World.name: Psychic World
Psychic World.summary: Psychic World is an action platform video game co-developed by Hertz and Sanritsu and published by Sega. Originally released in Japan for the MSX2 as Psycho World in 1988, it was later released as Psychic World on the Master System exclusively in Europe and Game Gear worldwide in 1991.
